_note: ArrayExpress/BioStudies experiments that are NOT mirrored from GEO and pass the Phase 1 scope rule. Found by searching ArrayExpress for neurofibromatosis / neurofibroma / schwannoma / MPNST / merlin NF2 / schwannomatosis (246 unique experiments, 59 not mirrored from GEO, 13 NF-related by title, 5 in scope after reading each record). Classified by hand from the BioStudies record, not by the LLM pass used for GEO. Sample-level labelling was not performed for these, so their sample counts are excluded from the coverage sums; n_samples is the assay/hybridisation count reported by ArrayExpress, which is not the same as the biological sample count.

records.title: Transcription profiling of human NF1 heterozygous (NF1+/-) melanocytes from a neurofibromatosis type 1 patient and NF1 wild type melanocytes
records.evidence: NF1+/- melanocytes from an NF1 patient compared with NF1 wild-type melanocytes; cafe-au-lait macule biology.
records.notes: Melanocyte/pigmentary phenotype has no dedicated manifestation label, so labelled Other.

records.title: Transcription profiling by array of human ST88 cells treated with FTS
records.evidence: Sample characteristics give DiseaseState 'neurofibromatosis-NF1' and CellLine ST88-14 (NF1 patient MPNST line); FTS vs vehicle.
records.notes: Two arrays only; treatment arm, not a case/control comparison.

records.title: Single cell RNA sequencing of subcutaneous nerves from 3-month-old control and mutant mice in the context of neurofibromatosis type 1
records.assay_type: RNA-seq of coding RNA from single cells
records.evidence: Genotype Prss56cre;R26mt;Nf1flox/flox vs littermate control; thickened subcutaneous nerves sampled before tumour formation.
records.notes: Pre-tumour nerve; labelled Plexiform neurofibroma as the tumour these nerves progress to.

records.title: Deciphering cellular and molecular signatures of malignant progression in neurofibromatosis type 1 using single-cell transcriptomics
records.manifestations: Plexiform neurofibroma;Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor (MPNST)
records.assay_type: RNA-seq of coding RNA from single cells
records.evidence: Prss56cre-driven Nf1 model sampled across neurofibroma-to-MPNST progression.

records.title: Transcription profiling of human neurofibromatosis type 1
records.manifestations: Plexiform neurofibroma;Malignant peripheral nerve sheath tumor (MPNST)
records.evidence: Plexiform neurofibroma (PN-*) and grade III MPNST samples from one NF1 cohort (Henri Mondor); two-colour arrays against a pooled reference.
records.notes: Pooled 'pool-cut' reference channel, not a biological control; NF1 status stated at series level only.
